column2: Sections are not labeled correctly
column3:
Test Steps
 * Create a GRG and using building detection to identify all buildings within the GRG boundaries
 * Use Section Drawing tool to enclose the area of your desired section (quadrant) 
 * Initiate building detection (ensure skip sections box is unchecked)
 * Note the intent of the Section Drawing tool is for the user to be able to label all buildings in a desired section within the GRG the same naming convention/color to differentiate that section or quadrant from the others. 
 * AI GRG stated that 9 buildings were detected within Section "A"
 * Note: There are far more than 9 identified buildings in Section A.
 * Note: Not all 9 detected and relabeled buildings are visible.  User must be extremely zoomed in to see certain building labels.
